== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] frozen [[Cookbook:Raspberry|raspberries]], thawed
* ¼ cup white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] (optional)
* ¼ cup unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla Extract|vanilla extract]]
* [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|Ice cream]] or [[Cookbook:Fruit|fruit]]

== Procedure ==
#Place berries on a baking sheet and sprinkle with half of the sugar. Place 5–6 [[Cookbook:Inch|inches]] under a preheated [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]], and [[Cookbook:Broiling|broil]] until well browned.
#Remove and set aside until cool.
#Combine cream, salt, and remaining sugar in a heavy [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium high heat. Add the raspberries, and [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] until berries break easily.
#Remove from the heat and set aside until cool. Purée in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]] or [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] until smooth. Alternatively, use an immersion blender directly in the saucepan.
#Pour mixture back into saucepan, and place over medium high heat. Bring to a boil and cook until liquid has reduced by ⅔.
#Stir in butter and vanilla until smooth, then cool.
#Pour sauce over ice cream or fruit and serve.

steps.text: Place berries on a baking sheet and sprinkle with half of the sugar. Place 5–6 inches under a preheated broiler, and broil until well browned.
Remove and set aside until cool.
Combine cream, salt, and remaining sugar in a heavy saucepan over medium high heat. Add the raspberries, and boil until berries break easily.
Remove from the heat and set aside until cool. Purée in a food processor or blender until smooth. Alternatively, use an immersion blender directly in the saucepan.
Pour mixture back into saucepan, and place over medium high heat. Bring to a boil and cook until liquid has reduced by ⅔.
Stir in butter and vanilla until smooth, then cool.
Pour sauce over ice cream or fruit and serve.
